translations.literal: From this time Deyu and Zongmin each formed factions and undermined each other—a struggle that would last nearly forty years.
translations.idiomatic: From this time Deyu and Zongmin each formed factions and undermined each other—a struggle that would last nearly forty years.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，冊回鶻嗣君為登囉羽錄沒密施句主毘伽崇德可汗。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the Uyghur heir was enthroned as Khan Dengluo Yulu Moimi Shijuzhu Pijia Chongde.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Uyghur heir was enthroned as Khan Dengluo Yulu Moimi Shijuzhu Pijia Chongde.

sentences.zh: 五月，丙申朔，回鶻遣都督、宰相等五百餘人來逆公主。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the first day of bingshen, the Uyghurs sent more than five hundred men including a governor and chief ministers to escort the princess.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the first day of bingshen, the Uyghurs sent more than five hundred men including a governor and chief ministers to escort the princess.

sentences.zh: 壬子，鹽鐵使王播奏：約榷茶額，每百錢加稅五十。

translations.literal: On renzi, Salt and Iron Commissioner Wang Bo memorialized: fixing the tea monopoly quota, an additional tax of fifty per hundred cash was proposed.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Salt and Iron Commissioner Wang Bo memorialized proposing to fix the tea monopoly quota and add a tax of fifty cash per hundred.

sentences.zh: 右拾遺李玨等上疏，以為「榷茶近起貞元多事之際，今天下無虞，所宜寬橫斂之目，而更增之，百姓何時當得息肩！」

translations.literal: Right Reminder Li Jue and others submitted a memorial arguing: "The tea monopoly arose recently in the troubled times of the Zhenyuan era; now the realm is untroubled—we ought to ease oppressive levies, not increase them. When will the people ever be able to lay down their burdens?"
translations.idiomatic: Right Reminder Li Jue and others submitted a memorial arguing, "The tea monopoly arose in the troubled Zhenyuan era; now the realm is at peace—we ought to ease oppressive levies, not increase them. When will the people ever be able to lay down their burdens?"

sentences.zh: 不從。

translations.literal: The proposal was not adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was not adopted.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，建王恪薨。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Prince Jian Ke died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Prince Jian Ke died.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以太和長公主嫁回鶻。

translations.literal: On guihai, the Princess of Taihe was married to the Uyghurs.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the Princess of Taihe was married to the Uyghurs.

sentences.zh: 公主，上之妹也。

translations.literal: The princess was the emperor's younger sister.
translations.idiomatic: The princess was the emperor's younger sister.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃聞唐與回鶻婚，六月，辛未，寇青寨堡，鹽州刺史李文悅擊卻之。

translations.literal: When Tibet heard that Tang was marrying a princess to the Uyghurs, in the sixth month, on xinwei, it raided Qingzhai Fort; Yanchou Prefect Li Wenyue drove it back.
translations.idiomatic: When Tibet heard that Tang was marrying a princess to the Uyghurs, in the sixth month, on xinwei, it raided Qingzhai Fort; Yanchou Prefect Li Wenyue drove it back.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，回鶻奏：「以萬騎出北庭，萬騎出安西，拒吐蕃以迎公主。」

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Uyghurs reported: "Ten thousand horsemen will ride out from Beiting and ten thousand from Anxi to block Tibet and escort the princess."
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Uyghurs reported, "Ten thousand horsemen will ride out from Beiting and ten thousand from Anxi to block Tibet and escort the princess."

sentences.zh: 初，劉總奏分所屬為三道：以幽、涿、營為一道，請除張弘靖為節度使；

translations.literal: Earlier Liu Zong had memorialized dividing his domain into three circuits: You, Zhuo, and Ying as one circuit, requesting Zhang Hongjing as military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Liu Zong had memorialized dividing his domain into three circuits: You, Zhuo, and Ying as one circuit, with Zhang Hongjing as military commissioner;

sentences.zh: 平、薊、媯、檀為一道，請除平盧節度使薛平為節度使；

translations.literal: Ping, Ji, Gui, and Tan as one circuit, requesting Pinglu military commissioner Xue Ping as military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Ping, Ji, Gui, and Tan as one circuit, with Pinglu military commissioner Xue Ping as military commissioner;

sentences.zh: 瀛、莫為一道，請除權知京兆尹盧士玫為觀察使。

translations.literal: Ying and Mo as one circuit, requesting Acting Metropolitan Governor Lu Shimei as overseer.
translations.idiomatic: Ying and Mo as one circuit, with Acting Metropolitan Governor Lu Shimei as overseer.

sentences.zh: 弘靖先在河東，以寬簡得眾，總與之鄰境，聞其風望，以燕人桀驁日久，故舉弘靖自代以安輯之。

translations.literal: Hongjing had previously been in Hedong, where his leniency and simplicity won the people; Zong bordered his territory, heard of his reputation, and because the men of Yan had long been fierce and unruly, recommended Hongjing to succeed him so as to pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Hongjing had previously served in Hedong, where his leniency and simplicity won the people; Zong bordered his territory, heard of his reputation, and because the men of Yan had long been fierce and unruly, recommended Hongjing to succeed him and pacify them.

sentences.zh: 平，嵩之子，知河朔風俗，而盡誠於國。

translations.literal: Ping was the son of Xue Song; he knew the customs of the Hebei region and was wholly loyal to the state.
translations.idiomatic: Ping was the son of Xue Song; he knew the customs of the Hebei region and was wholly loyal to the state.

sentences.zh: 士玫，則總妻族之親也。

translations.literal: Shimei was a relative of Zong's wife's clan.
translations.idiomatic: Shimei was a relative of Zong's wife's clan.

sentences.zh: 總又盡擇麾下宿將有功伉健難制者都知兵馬使朱克融等送之京師，乞加獎拔，使燕人有慕羨朝廷祿位之志。

translations.literal: Zong also selected all the veteran generals under him who were strong, capable, and hard to control—such as Army Commander Zhu Kerong—and sent them to the capital, asking that they be rewarded and promoted so the men of Yan would aspire to court rank and salary.
translations.idiomatic: Zong also selected all the veteran generals under him who were strong, capable, and hard to control—such as Army Commander Zhu Kerong—and sent them to the capital, asking that they be rewarded and promoted so the men of Yan would aspire to court rank and salary.

sentences.zh: 又獻征馬萬五千匹，然後削髮委去。

translations.literal: He also presented fifteen thousand campaign horses, and only then tonsured himself and departed.
translations.idiomatic: He also presented fifteen thousand campaign horses, and only then tonsured himself and departed.

sentences.zh: 克融，滔之孫也。

translations.literal: Kerong was the grandson of Zhu Tao.
translations.idiomatic: Kerong was the grandson of Zhu Tao.

sentences.zh: 是時上方酣宴，不留意天下之務，崔植、杜元穎無遠略，不知安危大體，苟崇重弘靖，惟割瀛、莫二州，以士玫領之，自餘皆統於弘靖。

translations.literal: At this time the emperor was deep in feasting and paid no heed to affairs of state; Cui Zhi and Du Yuanying lacked far-sighted plans and did not grasp the larger question of security—they merely honored Hongjing in form, cut off only Ying and Mo for Shimei to govern, and left everything else under Hongjing.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the emperor was deep in feasting and paid no heed to affairs of state; Cui Zhi and Du Yuanying lacked far-sighted plans and did not grasp the larger question of security—they merely honored Hongjing in form, cut off only Ying and Mo for Shimei to govern, and left everything else under Hongjing.

sentences.zh: 朱克融等久羈旅京師，至假丐衣食，日詣中書求官，植、元穎不之省。

translations.literal: Zhu Kerong and the others had long been detained in the capital, even begging for food and clothing; day after day they went to the Secretariat seeking office, but Zhi and Yuanying paid them no attention.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Kerong and the others had long been detained in the capital, even begging for food and clothing; day after day they went to the Secretariat seeking office, but Zhi and Yuanying paid them no attention.

sentences.zh: 及除弘靖幽州，勒克融輩歸本軍驅使，克融輩皆憤怨。

translations.literal: When Hongjing was appointed to Youzhou, Kerong and his fellows were ordered back to their original armies for service; they were all bitter and resentful.
translations.idiomatic: When Hongjing was appointed to Youzhou, Kerong and his fellows were ordered back to their original armies for service; they were all bitter and resentful.

sentences.zh: 先是，河北節度使皆親冒寒暑，與士卒均勞逸。

translations.literal: Previously, Hebei military commissioners had personally braved heat and cold and shared hardship and ease with their soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, Hebei military commissioners had personally braved heat and cold and shared hardship and ease with their soldiers.

sentences.zh: 及弘靖至，雍容驕貴，肩輿於萬眾之中，燕人訝之。

translations.literal: When Hongjing arrived, he was stately, proud, and exalted, carried in a palanquin amid ten thousand men—the men of Yan were astonished.
translations.idiomatic: When Hongjing arrived, he was stately, proud, and exalted, carried in a palanquin amid ten thousand men—the men of Yan were astonished.

sentences.zh: 弘靖莊默自尊，涉旬乃一出坐決事，賓客將吏罕得聞其言，情意不接，政事多委之幕僚。

translations.literal: Hongjing was solemn, silent, and proud; only after ten days would he emerge once to sit and decide affairs. Guests, officers, and clerks rarely heard him speak; he made no emotional connection, and delegated most government business to his staff.
translations.idiomatic: Hongjing was solemn, silent, and self-important; only after ten days would he emerge to sit and decide affairs. Guests, officers, and clerks rarely heard him speak; he kept his distance, and left most government business to his staff.

sentences.zh: 而所辟判官韋雍輩多年少輕薄之士，嗜酒豪縱，出入傳呼甚盛，或夜歸燭火滿街，皆燕人所不習也。

translations.literal: Yet the judicial commissioners he appointed, such as Wei Yong, were mostly young frivolous men who loved wine and lived extravagantly; their comings and goings were announced with great fanfare, and sometimes at night they returned with candles filling the streets—all customs the men of Yan were unaccustomed to.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the judicial commissioners he appointed, such as Wei Yong, were mostly young frivolous men who loved wine and lived extravagantly; their comings and goings were announced with great fanfare, and sometimes at night they returned with torches filling the streets—customs the men of Yan found alien.

sentences.zh: 詔以錢百萬緡賜將士，弘靖留其二十萬緡充軍府雜用，雍輩復裁刻軍士糧賜，繩之以法，數以反虜詬責吏卒，謂軍士曰：「今天下太平，汝曹能挽兩石弓，不若識一丁字！」

translations.literal: An edict granted a million strings of cash to reward the troops; Hongjing kept two hundred thousand for army headquarters miscellaneous expenses. Yong and his fellows further cut the soldiers' grain allotments and rewards, bound them with strict law, and repeatedly reviled officers and men as rebels and barbarians, saying to the soldiers: "The realm is at peace today—you who can draw a two-stone bow are worth less than knowing a single character!"
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted a million strings of cash to reward the troops; Hongjing kept two hundred thousand for army headquarters miscellaneous expenses. Yong and his fellows further cut the soldiers' grain allotments and rewards, bound them with strict law, and repeatedly reviled officers and men as rebels and barbarians, saying to the soldiers, "The realm is at peace today—you who can draw a two-stone bow are worth less than knowing a single character!"

sentences.zh: 由是軍中人人怨怒。

translations.literal: From this every man in the army nursed resentment and rage.
translations.idiomatic: From this every man in the army nursed resentment and rage.
